audience: ClairLabs programme, site and operations staff preparing to deliver patient recruitment

content: An AI-enabled digital solution for patient recruitment, covering identification, qualification and warm handover
One programme story from first touch to recruited participant
slides.purpose: Frame the programme: what ClairLabs does and where its responsibility begins and ends.
slides.title: ClairLabs - AI-Enabled Digital Solution for Patient Recruitment

content: Participant identification: finding potential participants across digital, HCP and data channels
Participant qualification: screening and confirming fit, digitally then human
Warm handover: referring qualified participants to sites with context, not cold lists
slides.purpose: Name the three phases before the site takes over.
slides.title: Participant Identification, Qualification and Warm Handover

content: Step 1 - primary digital screening: online screener plus contact details with initial consent
Step 2 - platform onboarding: qualified leads enter the centralized Patient Recruitment Platform
Step 3 - secondary human screening: RNN personnel connect, secure consent and run a detailed questionnaire
Step 4 - site referral and evaluation: referral to the nearest or preferred site for clinical evaluation and informed consent
Step 5 - trial recruitment: participants clearing site-specific evaluation are selected and recruited
slides.purpose: Teach the journey order so every handoff is expected, not improvised.
slides.title: The Recruitment Journey in Five Steps

content: Precise digital patient outreach and data-driven outreach find the right people
HCP outreach and patient advocacy groups work through trusted voices
Swift site alignment and go-live plus enriched patient experience carry participants over the line
slides.purpose: Show the six parallel pillars that answer recruitment challenges.
slides.title: Addressing Recruitment Challenges

content: Multichannel awareness: Google, Meta and endemic health sites, bought programmatically with audience segmentation
Top and mid-funnel: YouTube, programmatic display and educational content build high-intent consideration
Bottom-funnel close: lead forms, pre-screening tools and direct search ads finalize enrollment
70-90% initial non-conversion is why re-engagement and retargeting run throughout
slides.purpose: Explain how awareness becomes enrollment, and why retargeting is structural.
slides.title: The AI-Driven Patient Recruitment Funnel

content: Digital affinity: NPI-targeted programmatic ads and geo-fencing around medical conferences
KOL-based influence: key opinion leaders advocate through peer networks; physician-to-physician trust is the primary credibility driver
Offline presence: clinics, centers of excellence, primary care, plus libraries, coffee shops, stadiums and billboards
Complex and rare diseases lean hardest on KOL and offline presence
slides.purpose: Match each HCP motion to the disease it suits.
slides.title: HCP Outreach in Three Motions

content: Wearable app ecosystems: behavioral and physiological signals against health thresholds
Digital therapeutics populations, pharmacy networks and EHR-embedded matching algorithms
AI predictive recruitment: predicting clinical decision windows and triggering messaging as patients seek alternatives
The shift: from demographic-based outreach to behavioral and physiological identification
slides.purpose: List the five intelligence sources and the shift they represent.
slides.title: Data and Intelligence Strategies

content: PAG trust opens doors sponsors cannot open alone, including in rare-disease networks
Registries plus AI inclusion and exclusion matching filter precisely to hard-to-reach populations
Education-led conversion through ambassadors and webinars cuts misinformation and lifts retention
slides.purpose: Show how trust plus precision raises recruitment and cuts screen failures.
slides.title: Patient Advocacy Groups and Registries

content: Rapid activation of high-performing sites, with hyper-localized outreach in their vicinity
Real-time performance analytics with live data and rolling campaigns monitor site health
Investigator engagement programmes and standardized site tools, targeted at high patient-density locations
slides.purpose: Present site alignment as a continuous loop: activate, monitor, engage, optimize.
slides.title: Site Alignment and Go-Live

content: Journey mapping finds and fixes pain points from awareness to trial completion
Real-time engagement platforms keep communication consistent and active
Concierge-level personalized care: culturally sensitive, language-specific, matched to disease stage
Peer-driven community trust and continuous feedback loops instead of end-of-study surveys
Site referral compressed to minutes
